title: Interview candidate: cee (@cee.wtf), who won Top Chicken, put a wheelie game online hours after it was suggested, and answered people through "GTA 6 week"
summary: cee (2,524 followers) wrote 174 posts in the window. On Sat 14 Nov they won Top Chicken with "i love when people think their laptop somehow uses less power per task than a datacenter" (201 likes when the game counted it), and the digest shows them holding the game's record. On 13 Nov they wished for a Pikmin clone made of Bluesky mutuals and the build bot posted one six minutes later. On 17 Nov a member replied to one of their posts that a "realistic tractor wheelie sim game is possible"; under three hours later cee posted "do a sick wheelie at yard-shift.cee.wtf" (122 likes, with a video), and then added what people asked for in the replies. From 17 to 19 Nov they posted about the release of GTA 6 and answered questions about playing it. The card lists 10 of their replies with the post each one answered.

candidate.source: Found by the researcher in posts.jsonl; they are not in the digest's Interview material. By my own count with a similar rule they have 15 question-and-answer pairs from 12 askers. They are in the digest's games section as a Top Chicken winner.

checks.optOutList: not on the opt-out list (packages/scraper/config/optout.json, loaded through the tool)
checks.bio: not checked: the digest carries no bios and research has no network. The scraper reports that it excluded accounts with profile opt-outs before the digest was written.
checks.windowPosts: Read their 62 top-level posts and all of their replies to other people's questions that the data holds (15). Of their top-level posts, one is in a flagged story (a one-line post about a pope, flagged identity). Some posts are about their apartment, their job review, their parents' house, their body and stock trades; none of those is on the card. No post asks not to be quoted.

didInWindow: Won Top Chicken on 14 Nov. Asked the build bot for "Pikmin clone where all your pikmin are Bluesky moots" (13 Nov 04:43; the bot posted pikmoot.bisks.net at 04:49). Posted a video captioned "chimeralion" (13 Nov, 79 likes) and an image captioned "claude makes an instruction binder" (13 Nov, 45 likes). Put a game at yard-shift.cee.wtf (17 Nov 23:51), in which, going by another member's screenshot description, a skid steer loader does wheelies in a yard; added skid marks, a driver who hangs off the side and a "Woot!" after a member asked for them (18 Nov 00:31). Posted through the GTA 6 release, including a "First hour review".
couldBeShown: yard-shift.cee.wtf is a public page; the post has a video with no alt text, which the researcher has not seen. A member's screenshot of it has this alt text: "Screenshot from a cartoony 3D construction game. A yellow skid steer loader with a black frame and a caged cab is tipped back onto its rear wheels, nose in the air, its arms fully extended so the bucket is up overhead. Two loose wheels sit in the bucket. A small worker in an orange high-vis vest and yellow hard hat hangs off the side of the machine, one arm flung up as if cheering or falling. A little “Woot!” message floats at the top of the screen. The setting is a concrete yard with tire skid marks, a chain-link fence and rounded low-poly trees under a gray sky."
pikmoot.bisks.net, built by @buildthis.bisks.net from cee's wish (the digest lists it under "Got built").
The "chimeralion" video and the "instruction binder" image have no alt text in the data; not seen.

notUnderstood: I have not seen the video or images, so I cannot say what "chimeralion" or the "instruction binder" look like, or what the image is that their post of 17 Nov quotes ("list of unpredictable things but are obvious in hindsight"); the replies suggest machines trained in simulation. "Cee machines" in the first answer is their own coinage on their name. I have not played GTA 6 and take the answers about it at face value.
leftOut: A question about the typeface in the "instruction binder" image (the asker's handle contains a word some would read as a slur). A reply about air travel on the day of the FAA outage. Replies about dental insurance and about construction jobs (health, jobs). A reply to a post mocking someone for not caring about GTA. A reply under their own post about a soda cup lid, whose caption is a sexual joke. Posts about their apartment, a performance review, their parents' house and buying stock options.
sensitive: A Top Chicken winner may be named, with the winning post (R7); the digest's games section has the figures, and the games lane will carry them. Some of cee's other posts this week are about housing trouble, work and money (R10) and about their body; none is on the card, and none should be reached for. The GTA answers mention a commercial game; the "gravel" prompt is another member's joke about that game, not about a person. Five of the posts listed come from an account that was shown in the previous episode (and one from the build bot, also shown), and two prompts come from accounts that spoke in it. The wheelie game was suggested by another member (@shimmermathlabs.com), who should be credited if it is shown. One asker is a small account.
